statement:
Case RF-6120 lists a refund of **USD 23,000.00**, but the amount paid was **USD 230.00**.

I haven’t issued the refund because of this discrepancy. Should the refund amount be USD 230.00?
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer names the specific problem — the refund of "USD 23,000.00" exceeds the "USD 230.00" paid — and refuses to issue it, offering the correct value.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
